'''Blitzmane''' is a [[Lightning]] type Support [[Critters|Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Blitzmane]] at 6 silver moons after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Those giant thunder wings are the mark of a true king. Stormlion is no lion cub, but an undisputed Tatari powerhouse. Any [[Zobos|Zobo]] that dares come near is easily turned to dust."

Stormlion is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

==Appearance==
A large, yellow, angry looking lion with spiky wings. It retains its bolt on its head and tail, but they are larger than before, its cheek bolts are more prominent. It has a white mouth, dark ears, and large orange eyebrows. Its eyes are black with small yellow pupils. Its wings are larger than before, and it now has large bolt shaped growths on its forearms. 

Stormlion's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces yellow and orange with off-white and brown.

== Trivia ==

* Prior to the update on 2/10/2026, its bio used to say: "Stormlion's stage four barely changed. Bigger wings, but still can't see a mane..."
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "'Blitzmane isn't evolving into a new species, so we need to find a new way to stimulate its mutation...' ---Unnamed Log"
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26 its bio description said: "Every flap of Stormlion's wings rumbles with thunder, summoning tempests from above so powerful that even Zapantler's not brave enough to stir up trouble."

==Strategy==
A simple Lightning Tank, it can knock back Zobos a short distance, helping to slow down the Zobos' progress and group up multiple Zobos together. Place in front for max effectiveness. Its Damage boost can make nearby DPS do extra damage, so sometimes placing them closer is helpful.
